_about: Labelled retrieval queries over scripts/eval_data/corpus_v2 (97 upstream docs: cargo, compose-spec, gh, prometheus, ripgrep). Report-only: no floors. 'expected' is 'rel/path.md::Heading path' (file relative to corpus_v2). 'paraphrase' holds plain-language questions. 'also_valid' grades other acceptable answers: 2 = equally correct, 1 = partially answers. 'dev' are the 40 queries of issue #75. 'held_out' was written by a fresh session from the corpus alone, excluding every dev query, intent and answering section, and committed before the identifier-lookup change it measures; it must never be used to tune. Labels were proposed by two reviewers independently and reconciled in a joint pass. 'mixed' (#78) holds questions that name an identifier verbatim, 4 per project per split: dev and held_out were written by two separate fresh sessions from the corpus alone (held_out without seeing dev, the issue or any design), labelled independently by Codex and Gemini - who chose the same expected section for all 40 - and reconciled (also_valid grade 1 only for a section that answers an explicit part of the question). Committed before any change it measures; its held_out must never be used to tune. The held_out paraphrase and identifier strata were retired after they decided #80 and replaced (#100) by 40 queries written by a fresh session from the corpus alone, given only the answer sections to avoid (every dev, retired and mixed label) and no query text; labelled independently by Codex and Gemini (same expected section for 39 of 40) and reconciled by an isolated session. #118 retired those 40 as well, after #96 and #83 ran them as a final cell, and replaced them by the same recipe: 40 queries written by a fresh isolated session from the corpus alone, given only the sections it could choose from (every dev, retired and mixed label excluded) and no query text, at most 2 per document per kind except ripgrep identifiers (all 4 from CHANGELOG.md, its only candidate document that names identifiers); labelled blind in a sandbox by Codex and Gemini (same expected section for 40 of 40) and reconciled by an isolated session (6 rows where one labeller proposed an also_valid section; none kept). Review found one paraphrase that repeated its answer's heading; a new session rewrote it and both labellers agreed on it. The retired rows remain in git history.
